name: Trinity
summary: One compatibility surface for EmblemWeave, fefw-recomp and ObeliskChamber, without erasing the character of any launcher.

houses.name: EmblemWeave
houses.evidence: The development build loaded an NXP panel, persisted settings and rendered it under F1 > Advanced > Mods.
houses.adapter: Native egui page and NXP host adapter

houses.name: fefw-recomp
houses.evidence: The actual fefw-recomp 0.2.13 launcher window loaded the Trinity page, built from the v0.2.13 tag. The 0.2.13 game runtime was not exercised.
houses.adapter: Host-styled Trinity page plus a future NXP loader

houses.name: ObeliskChamber
houses.evidence: The actual ObeliskChamber 0.3.2 launcher window loaded the Trinity page. The game runtime was not exercised.
houses.adapter: Panel-styled Trinity screen plus a future NXP loader

listings.name: Trinity Core
listings.summary: The shared capability registry and NXP bridge. It discovers the host, negotiates interfaces and exposes one panel model.

listings.name: Trinity Hub
listings.summary: The section you are looking at: one catalog, three native presentations, and no replacement of the host's navigation.

listings.name: Prefix Registry
listings.summary: Host-owned namespaces such as emblemweave. and neutral namespaces such as trinity. and nxp., with collision checks at load time.

listings.name: NXP Demo Panel
listings.summary: The first proof: a native panel, two persisted settings and a frame counter loaded by the EmblemWeave development build.

listings.name: Compatibility Bridge
listings.summary: Maps the existing NxModApi 3, 4 and 5 entry points onto NXP without forcing a host API version bump.

capabilities.name: Host discovery
capabilities.detail: Host id, name, version and plugin directory cross the ABI once.

capabilities.name: Native panel
capabilities.detail: The host draws the widgets, so each launcher keeps its own controls and input model.

capabilities.name: Persisted settings
capabilities.detail: Namespaced keys survive a restart and stay owned by the host.

capabilities.name: Frame hook
capabilities.detail: Optional per-frame work runs on the game's presenting thread.
